question: Sonal Mansingh is associated with which dance form?
solution: The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam and Odissi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Sonal Mansingh is a prominent Indian classical dancer who specializes in Bharatanatyam and Odissi. • For her contributions to promoting ‘Classical dances’, she has received accolades from many national and international organizations. • She was the youngest recipient of Padma Bhushan in 1992. • In 2003, Sonal became the first Indian woman dancer to be awarded Padma Vibhushan.
